Residential ChaaS programs are currently offered by many electricity providers and independent entities for SFH. This example demonstrates the potential economic savings from actualizing favorable electricity pricing structures via ChaaS-controlled home charging of a commuter EV. These savings accrue relative to a baseline case, where the EV owner pays up front for EVSE procurement and installation and does not take advantage of any special electricity pricing structures.
